meta_description:
67K likes, 355 comments - komalpandeyofficial on October 7, 2026: "Story time: 
An astrologer once told me that this is my last birth on planet earth, and weirdly, the very first thought that came to my mind was, “Fuck… I won’t meet Siddharth in my next birth because this is my last?”

And I think that says everything about what you are to me.
Happy Birthday to the most important person of my life. 

The boy who never misses his morning beetroot and celery juice with a side of egg whites. Who loves to drive, a good pizza, flowers, drinking absurd amounts of water, and who probably loves his skincare routine a little more than he loves me.

But also the boy who would do anything to see me become the fullest version of myself. 

I wish this boy ridiculous amounts of joy, success beyond his own imagination, good health, peace and every single thing his heart quietly hopes for. And I know it hopes for more and more and more skincare. 

And I genuinely mean this from the deepest part of me ki isko meri umar bhi lag jaaye. Because the world can do without me for a little while, but a little more time with Siddharth in it will always make it a more beautiful, kinder place.

Happy birthday, my love. If this really is my last lifetime, I’m just very, very grateful I got to find you in it. 🤍".
